integrity: The proof uses the source's exact join formula, sum-product certificate identity, and exact dyadic phase law. The new mass bounds are deterministic consequences of those identities; the bundled computation is only a finite replay.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to optimized basic s-composable schedules generated by recursive joins. It does not classify the number or locations of long steps, and the maximum-step statement is a lower bound rather than an exact asymptotic.
title: Long-step mass polarization in optimized recursive gradient schedules
